subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw accept skill-authored dashboard configuration actions in SKILL.md, and what URL/action trust policy should govern them?
rationale: The change would turn third-party skill metadata into actionable links inside an authenticated admin UI, so automation cannot safely choose the public contract or trust boundary.

options.title: Adopt a typed config action
options.body: Define a narrow action shape with validated URL semantics, default label rules, trust display, and docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Use existing surfaces for now
options.body: Decline new fields and steer skills to `homepage`, Skill Cards, ClawHub pages, or docs until a broader action model is designed.

options.title: Defer to plugin/ClawHub design
options.body: Keep this open only as input to a larger plugin settings or ClawHub skill metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt a typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a narrow action shape with validated URL semantics, default label rules, trust display, and docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mostly Control UI/admin URL trust and dashboard product semantics, where the history points to Peter as a strong adjacent owner.
